name: El Atazar (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Atazar (wavy white and blue and a tower on green).
history: Municipal flag of El Atazar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
